title: FLA import: AS2 className not decoded from CPicPage afterData
description: The className field (e.g. com.example.MyClip) stored in Symbol N stream CPicPage afterData is explicitly not yet decoded. Import always leaves it as empty string, silently losing AS2 class associations and breaking attachMovie/new ClassName() workflows. Find className in CPicPage afterData, wire through Fla8SymbolInfo, and set it in flash8-import.ts.
